name: product-hero-square
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural / premium product campaign. Reference image 1 is the authoritative physical Princess Bloom belt from front, side, rear. Reference 2 demonstrates real position across the LOWER ABDOMEN and realistic small scale. Reference 3 is the original brand logo, use the exact mark on the shell, no new logo. PRODUCT IDENTITY LOCK: preserve reference pink elongated low-profile soft rounded rectangular shell, BLACK VERTICAL OVAL DISPLAY ON THE VIEWER'S LEFT, logo PRINCESS with BLOOM below on center-right, small embossed PINK HEART on far RIGHT, gray terrycloth padded back, pink woven elastic strap and pink buckle. The window is unlit black, small blue protective pull tab on its right rim, preserve two tiny dark-gold leaf forms on the screen's left. No invented digital temperature, no gray strap, no screen on right, no central buttons, no thicker shell. Belt worn over dark fitted clothing low on abdomen as reference, about 23cm wide, not at ribs and not huge. Keep adult faces and hands natural, realistic skin, camera photography, soft natural light, warm cream blush palette, believable lifestyle, no illustration/3D, no text overlays, no extra logo elsewhere, no watermarks. ONE independent photograph, NEVER collage, montage, grid, split-screen or multiple views.
Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE SQUARE 1:1 studio hero photograph, NOT landscape. Use the additional fourth image as exact desired physical product and photographic style, maintain same object, logo, pink strap and pink satin/cherry blossoms. Frame a LITTLE WIDER so the WHOLE pink shell and strap are contained in the central 70% of image WIDTH and central 50% of image HEIGHT. Shell remains elongated horizontal with screen LEFT, original logo right and heart far right. Beautiful flowing blush satin background must extend to ALL FOUR EDGES in a natural full photograph, NO blank padding, no flat bars. Delicate cherry blossoms in opposite corners, refined gentle diffused daylight. Needs to work cropped to both square desktop and wide mobile while keeping entire physical belt visible. Product occupies center of square with visible whole strap. Professional actual-camera product shot, no added copy, preserve exact original logo reference. High resolution square.
